# Senior Platform Engineer — Acme

**Location:** Remote (EU) · **Type:** Full-time · **Posted:** 2026-08-28

Acme is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to build the internal developer platform used by our AI
product teams — CI/CD, service scaffolding, and the model-inference gateway.

## Responsibilities

- Own the internal platform: paved-path service templates, deploy tooling
- Run the LLM inference gateway (routing, quotas, cost observability)
- Improve build and test infrastructure for ~40 engineers

## Requirements

- 5+ years building internal platforms or developer tooling
- Strong TypeScript; Go or Python a plus
- Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code

## Compensation

€120,000–€145,000 + equity. EU visa sponsorship available.
